title: Scan Pool
subtitle: Manage configuration pools for share scans

form.basicDescription: Pool name and scan performance parameters

includeServers.title: Include Hostnames
includeServers.description: Hostnames that will be included in the scan. Supports wildcards (e.g. SRV-*, *-DB-*).
includeServers.info1: Add hostnames that should be included in the scan
includeServers.info2: Wildcards: Use SRV-* to include all that start with SRV-
includeServers.info3: If the list is empty, all hostnames will be considered

excludeServers.title: Exclude Hostnames
excludeServers.description: Hostnames that will be excluded from the scan. Exclusion always takes precedence over inclusion. Supports wildcards.
excludeServers.info1: Hostnames in this list will be always ignored, even if they are in the inclusion list
excludeServers.info2: Wildcards: Use *-DEV-* to exclude development hostnames
excludeServers.info3: The exclusion list always takes precedence over the inclusion list

includeIps.title: Include IP/Subnet
includeIps.description: IPs or subnets that will be included in the scan. Supports CIDR notation.
includeIps.info1: Add individual IPs (e.g. 192.168.1.1) or subnets in CIDR notation (e.g. 10.0.0.0/24)
includeIps.info2: If the list is empty, all IPs will be considered

excludeIps.title: Exclude IP/Subnet
excludeIps.description: IPs or subnets that will be excluded from the scan. Exclusion always takes precedence over inclusion.
excludeIps.info1: IPs and subnets in this list will be always ignored, even if they are in the inclusion list
excludeIps.info2: Use CIDR to exclude entire subnets (e.g. 192.168.99.0/24)
excludeIps.info3: The exclusion list always takes precedence over the inclusion list

toast.invalidIp: Invalid IP. Use IPv4 (e.g. 192.168.1.1) or CIDR (e.g. 10.0.0.0/24)
toast.itemExists: Item already exists in the list
